truth_frontmatter.change_reason: R0: Rolo multi-git workspace exposed that parent feature pool and stable service bindings are mixed; add service-scoped pool truth before implementation

acceptance_criteria.theme: Rolo/multi-git governance 必须支持显式 `role=primary` root；global service bindings 的 `repo_root` 只能指稳定 repo root，不能指版本 worktree；`multi_git_workspace` 是合法 topology_kind
Governance parser/render/doctor 必须保留 primary binding 顺序无关语义，metadata verify 接受 `multi_git_workspace`，并在 service binding 指向 `.worktrees/feature-*` 时给出可执行迁移结果

Workspace pool 必须支持 `workspace-pool-v2` 或等价 schema：一个 feature parent lease 下包含 services lease map，服务 lease 记录 service_key、repo_root、branch、base_branch、worktree_path、lease_holder、leased_at、released_at、git_head；release 只归还 lease，不删除 worktree

Implement admission 对 multi-git/nested child repo 必须为每个 participating 且 writable service 创建或复用真实 service worktree；分支来自 `per_service_canonical_branch`，baseline 来自 `per_service_baseline_branch`，路径来自 `service_worktree_path_pattern` 或默认 `.beacon/worktrees/<version>/<feature_slug>/services/<service_key>`
GitScopeGraph/topology gate/write guard 必须以 explicit primary + service scopes 汇总；parent worktree 不能授权 service write；任何 service branch/cwd/head/baseline mismatch 都阻断 implement dispatch
Rolo v2.3.3/v2.3.4 fixture 必须验证：primary 是 `/Users/apple/Developer/Company/rolo`，participating service map 精确覆盖版本合同，`workspace_admission_cwd_mismatch` 不再由 first-service-primary 误判触发
Existing single_repo、dedicated-worktree、pooled feature-level lease 行为保持回归通过；本包不得引入旧 package shape 兼容 reader、soft skip write authorization 或 hook-only gate

test_rows.assertion: multi-git governance contains explicit primary root, service repo roots are stable, and any `.worktrees/feature-*` service binding is reported as migration input rather than accepted as global truth
parser/render/doctor preserve role=primary, accept `multi_git_workspace`, and do not derive primary from the first service binding
admit writes parent + services lease entries, release marks all leases released without deleting directories, and corrupt state fails closed
multi-git implement admission creates real service worktrees for all participating writable services using per-service branch, per-service baseline and governed path pattern
GitScopeGraph records explicit primary + service scopes, write guard blocks parent-only service writes, and branch/cwd/head/baseline mismatch blocks dispatch
Rolo fixture resolves v2.3.3/v2.3.4 with root primary, exact participating service map, and no first-service `workspace_admission_cwd_mismatch`
existing single_repo, dedicated-worktree, feature-level pooled lease, GitScopeGraph and unified implement admission regressions remain green
skipped admission, mkdir-only service path, empty gitlink, parent-only write, bad baseline and old-shape compatibility attempts are rejected with reason codes
